block.sql_database.model.title: SQL Database
block.sql_database.model.description: Run parameterized SQL queries on SQLite or PostgreSQL.
block.sql_database.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.sql_database.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.sql_database.help_driver: sqlite uses a private database file in this node's storage. postgresql connects to the server configured below.
block.sql_database.help_operation: query reads rows in a read-only transaction. execute, insert_rows and upsert write data and need allow_writes.
block.sql_database.help_sql: One statement. Bind message values with :name or %(name)s placeholders; values are never inserted into the SQL text.
block.sql_database.help_table: Target table, optionally schema.table. Names are quoted exactly as written.
block.sql_database.help_columns: JSON array of column names. Every params object must provide each of them (null allowed); other keys are ignored.
block.sql_database.help_conflict_columns: Columns of the unique key used by ON CONFLICT, e.g. ["sku"].
block.sql_database.help_update_columns: Columns updated on conflict. Empty updates every non-conflict column; all columns as conflict columns means DO NOTHING.
block.sql_database.help_allow_writes: Writes stay disabled until this is checked. Each message is applied in one transaction: all of it or nothing.
block.sql_database.help_sqlite_file: File name inside this node's storage, ending in .sqlite3, .sqlite or .db. No folders, links or ATTACH.
block.sql_database.help_pg_host: Server host name, IP address or absolute Unix-socket directory. Nothing is contacted until a message arrives.
block.sql_database.help_pg_user: Database role. Use a role with only the privileges this node needs.
block.sql_database.help_pg_password_ref: Wallet reference such as secret://workspace/pg_app, never the password itself. Empty sends no password.
block.sql_database.help_pg_sslmode: TLS mode. verify-full checks the certificate and host name. disable is accepted only for local connections.
block.sql_database.help_statements: Optional named statements, e.g. {"init":{"operation":"execute","sql":"CREATE TABLE ..."}}. Select one with {"$statement":"init","$params":{...}}.
block.sql_database.help_timeout_sec: Deadline for connecting, locks and every statement of one message. Stop interrupts the running statement.
block.sql_database.help_max_rows: Maximum rows published on the rows output.
block.sql_database.help_max_result_bytes: Maximum size of the published rows, in bytes.
block.sql_database.help_truncate_results: When a limit is exceeded, publish the first rows with truncated true instead of failing.
block.sql_database.help_max_batch_rows: Maximum parameter objects in one array message.
block.sql_database.help_max_params_bytes: Maximum size of one params message, in bytes.
block.sql_database.help_sqlite_max_datab: The SQLite file cannot grow beyond this size; a write that would exceed it fails and is rolled back.
block.sql_database.help_pg_sslrootcert: Optional CA certificate: an absolute PEM file path, or system for the system store (libpq 16+). Empty uses the libpq default.
